stories.title: No 10 insists RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers
stories.summary: Downing Street says RAF Fairford remains safe after the US withdrew its B-1 bombers from the base. PM Andy Burnham said there were 'strong indications' Iran was involved in the incident, while US Secretary of State Marco Rubio described it as 'clearly involving the hands of a foreign actor'.

stories.title: America's bomber withdrawal points to wider UK-US friction
stories.summary: Analysis from Politico suggests the US withdrawal of bombers from RAF Fairford is symptomatic of deeper tensions between London and Washington. PM Burnham has been notably muted in public comments on the relationship.

stories.title: Carers call for help before next general election over social care reform
stories.summary: Carers groups are calling for urgent support as the government's planned social care changes are expected to save £15bn a year by the end of the 2030s. Downing Street has not yet set out full details of the reform.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🤖 UK's G20 presidency expected to push Burnham toward global AI treaty
stories.summary: A Guardian commentary argues that the UK's G20 presidency will thrust PM Burnham to the centre of the global stage, with pressure to secure agreement on a process toward a global treaty on AI regulation, alongside food and climate economy priorities.

stories.title: 🤖 GDS makes AI updates to government's digital governance standards
stories.summary: The Government Digital Service has updated the UK's Digital Service Standard to incorporate AI-specific governance guidance, signalling a more structured government approach to AI deployment in public services.

stories.title: 🤖 Senior Treasury official named first head of AI Economics Institute
stories.summary: A senior HM Treasury official has been appointed to lead the newly created AI Economics Institute, underscoring government intent to embed economic analysis into AI policymaking.

stories.title: 🏗️ Government to create specialist insourcing unit
stories.summary: The government has announced plans to create a specialist insourcing unit to bring specialist functions back in-house, signalling a broader shift away from external contractors.

stories.title: 🏗️ DWP takes Universal Credit review work back in-house
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions is insourcing its Universal Credit review work, reducing dependence on external suppliers in a move consistent with the government's wider insourcing agenda.

stories.title: 🏢 Government buys time on shared services — extends contracts rather than re-procuring
stories.summary: The government is extending existing shared services contracts rather than launching new procurements, signalling a cautious approach to a major spend area and possible review of the shared services strategy.

stories.title: 🤖 OfDIA authorises first use of UK CertifID digital trust mark
stories.summary: The Office for Digital Identities and Attributes (OfDIA) has authorised the first use of the UK CertifID trust mark, helping citizens and organisations recognise digital verification services that meet government standards.

stories.title: 💰 Burnham's Budget must not be overshadowed by the OBR
stories.summary: The FT editorial board argues the upcoming Burnham Budget must stand on its own merits and not be constrained by the OBR's fiscal framework, amid signs that the Chancellor is working toward a growth-oriented fiscal statement.

topics.description: House of Commons, Lords, PMQs, debates, legislation

topics.name: Labour Party
topics.description: Labour party news, policy, internal politics

stories.title: Labour polling at highest level since last year as Reform slips
stories.summary: A new YouGov voting intention poll shows Labour gaining three percentage points, reaching its highest level in over a year, while Reform UK support is declining.

stories.title: Green Party split over 'Zionism is racism' conference vote
stories.summary: Labour MPs and European Greens have demanded clarity from the Green Party after a 'Zionism is racism' motion passed at its conference. Green deputy leader Zack Polanski says he will not accept exclusion from Labour discussions.

stories.title: Labour rejects Tory call to abolish Environment Agency and Natural England
stories.summary: Labour has issued a detailed response to Conservative conference proposals to scrap the Environment Agency and Natural England, calling the plans an 'appalling lack of judgement'.

stories.title: Tories want to duck Burnham's social care fight, say shadow cabinet members
stories.summary: Three members of Kemi Badenoch's shadow Cabinet have said the party may choose not to unveil a major care offer before the next general election, in an attempt to avoid a difficult policy fight with the Burnham government.

stories.title: Badenoch trying to match Farage step for step — 'a dance of death for the Tories'
stories.summary: Guardian analysis argues that Badenoch's strategy of competing with Nigel Farage for right-wing support risks alienating traditional 'Blue Wall' voters. Political experts say there is no path to a Tory majority without reclaiming moderate conservatives.

stories.title: Conservative conference Birmingham: Tory plan to beat Reform revealed
stories.summary: Those around Badenoch are betting that Reform will become ever more extreme, driving moderate right-wingers back to the Tories. Inheritance tax cuts and a pledge to scrap Environment Agency headline the conference agenda.

topics.name: Liberal Democrats
topics.description: Lib Dem party news, policy positions

stories.title: Ed Davey sets out Lib Dems' pitch to London at conference
stories.summary: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey has set out the party's pitch to London voters at the Lib Dem conference, with BBC Politics Live providing live coverage of his keynote speech.

topics.name: Reform UK
topics.description: Nigel Farage, Reform UK party news

stories.title: Farage: Labour is launching an 'existential assault on parliamentary democracy'
stories.summary: Nigel Farage has published an article accusing the Burnham government of attacking parliamentary democracy, following the cross-party backing for the PM's new anti-disinformation unit — which Farage called an attack on free speech.

stories.title: Conservative plans to slash overseas aid budget — Reform says Tories are 'copying our policies'
stories.summary: Reform UK has claimed that Conservative proposals to cut overseas aid are simply copying its own policies. Reform had previously announced it would cap overseas aid at £1bn.

stories.title: Tories bet Reform will go too far right — freeing moderate vote
stories.summary: Those around Badenoch are confident that Reform becoming ever-more extreme — particularly with the rise of 'Restore', a new hard-right movement — will drive moderate right-wingers back to the Conservative Party.

stories.title: Scotland's First Minister renews independence referendum calls after Burnham conference speech
stories.summary: Scotland's First Minister has renewed calls for an independence referendum following Andy Burnham's Labour conference speech, arguing the speech confirms Scotland's interests differ from Westminster's direction.

stories.title: Wings Over Scotland raises £30k for SNP referendum fund court case
stories.summary: The pro-independence website Wings Over Scotland has raised more than £30,000 to pursue a judicial review into how police and prosecutors handled the investigation into the SNP referendum fund.

stories.title: SNP needs to fix council tax to tackle child poverty, critics warn
stories.summary: The Scottish Government is under pressure to reform council tax as charities warn it will miss child poverty targets by a wide margin without radical action. SNP has challenged Labour over a lack of comparative poverty assessments.

topics.name: Cabinet Office
topics.description: Government reshuffles, senior appointments, cross-dept policy

stories.title: Free careers support now available through Jobcentres across England
stories.summary: People across England can now access free careers advice alongside employment support through Jobcentres, making it easier to get help finding work — a cross-government initiative involving the Cabinet Office.

stories.title: PM Burnham dodges questions on major infrastructure project backed by former chancellor
stories.summary: Andy Burnham repeatedly declined to confirm whether he supports a major national infrastructure project that former Chancellor Rachel Reeves had backed, raising questions about cross-government priorities in the new administration.

topics.name: Elections & By-elections
topics.description: Upcoming or recent elections, results, polls

stories.title: Labour polling at highest level since last year; Reform slipping in latest YouGov poll
stories.summary: Labour has gained three percentage points in the latest YouGov voting intention poll, reaching its highest level in over a year. Reform UK support is declining as Tories hold steady.

stories.title: Holborn and St Pancras by-election: Green Party tensions as Polanski refuses exclusion
stories.summary: Green deputy leader Zack Polanski is refusing to accept exclusion from cross-party activities linked to the upcoming Holborn and St Pancras by-election following the Green Party's controversial 'Zionism is racism' conference vote.
